limitations: Training collection spans 72 changing parameter versions and independently sampled init states; these counts are not a fixed-policy success estimate.
All-success groups also have exactly zero LOO; zero does not mean absence of learned skill.
Native partial predicates do not measure continuous approach, contact quality, or probability of future completion.
This is descriptive credit availability, not an attribution of the failed generalization or evidence that shaped rewards will help.
